note: Held-out goals for the template patterns. Labels were written before any run. Not a tuning set: score it for a report and do not add rules from its misses. Two ideas behind its goals were told to the author of the local rules after the first score (a heavy resource is performance; a held behavior worded as a prohibition is a refactoring), so the local pick's score here is not blind for those two.
